description: This file implements the HostResolverInternalResult class hierarchy, including methods for serialization/deserialization, validation, and handling different result types (data, metadata, error, alias) related to DNS host resolution.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalResult
classes.description: Base class representing a DNS host resolution result, with subclasses for specific result types.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalDataResult
classes.description: Represents a successful DNS resolution with associated data such as endpoints, strings, and hosts.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalMetadataResult
classes.description: Represents DNS resolution metadata, including connection endpoint metadata.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalErrorResult
classes.description: Represents an error result in DNS resolution, including an error code.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalAliasResult
classes.description: Represents an alias result pointing to another domain name.

methods.name: FromValue
methods.description: Deserializes a base::Value into a HostResolverInternalResult object.

methods.name: AsData
methods.description: Casts to HostResolverInternalDataResult, asserting the type.

methods.name: AsMetadata
methods.description: Casts to HostResolverInternalMetadataResult, asserting the type.

methods.name: AsError
methods.description: Casts to HostResolverInternalErrorResult, asserting the type.

methods.name: AsAlias
methods.description: Casts to HostResolverInternalAliasResult, asserting the type.

methods.name: HostResolverInternalResult
methods.description: Constructor initializing common fields for all result types.

methods.name: ValidateValueBaseDict
methods.description: Validates the base dictionary structure for deserialization.

methods.name: ToValueBaseDict
methods.description: Serializes common fields into a dictionary.
